content: Patients experiencing food insecurity often resort to consuming low-cost, carbohydrate-dense foods due to financial constraints. This dietary pattern can significantly elevate the risk of hyperglycemia. Furthermore, irregular or inconsistent food intake in these individuals can predispose them to episodes of hypoglycemia, particularly if they are being treated with sulfonylureas or insulin. Healthcare providers should carefully account for these risks when formulating treatment plans. It is also recommended that providers assist these patients in accessing food assistance programs or resources to help stabilize their dietary patterns and improve overall health outcomes.
